scope: Twelve selected relevant systems: seven agent frameworks, four established reinterpretation tools, one benchmark. Not an exhaustive census of all agentic HEP projects.

method.remote_pins: git ls-remote HEAD, plus shallow verified clones for GitLab sources
method.github_trees: GitHub REST git/trees API at immutable commit
method.source_inspection: Documentation and selected public interfaces, outside the Ravel tree. No competitor implementation copied into Ravel.
method.execution: No new installations, framework trials, event generation, or fits; earlier outcomes are separately labeled.
comparison_limits: Source availability is not execution success.
Code presence is not physics fidelity.
Matched prompts do not imply matched executed physics.
Refusals are unmet product requests, not delivery credit.
No statistical superiority or uniqueness established.
